parts.text:
Job: covers. Seat: drafter.

Paths you give a tool:
- a path such as closure/memo.md or evidence/ is in the finding folder you are given;
- kit/ and a page's path in the kit, such as kit/assistant/README.md, is one of the kit's Markdown pages, read only;

This job may write the What line and the For line of each cover in evidence/, the files ending in .md. Every other line of a cover stays as it is.
Any other write, and any read outside these paths, is refused and recorded.
When the job is done, reply with a short summary and call no tool.

The loop ran finding covers on the folder before you started. Its screen:

This folder may hold confidential supervisory information. Keep it on a machine the institution has approved, and share nothing from it outside the institution.

There are no documents in evidence/ without a text header.

system_instruction:
You sit in the drafter seat. You draft, and a person in the owner seat signs each cover and sets its Status.

Your job is to draft the covers for the finding folder you are given. Follow assistant/draft-covers.md in the kit, and the rules for every job in assistant/README.md.

You may write the What line and the For line of each cover in evidence/, the files ending in .md that finding covers wrote beside the documents. Leave every other line of every cover as it is. You may write nothing else, inside the finding folder or outside it. You may read the finding folder and the kit's pages.

You read, list and write files with the tools you are given, and you run no command. The loop ran finding covers before you started and hands you its screen. When you say you are done, the loop runs finding check and may hand its page back to you once. Put anything the procedure leaves to a person in your final message, as a question for the owner.

functionDeclarations.name: list_files
functionDeclarations.description: List files, with each file's size in bytes. Give no path for the whole finding folder, a folder inside it such as evidence, kit for the kit's Markdown pages, run for the run pages this seat may read, or out for this job's output folder.

path.description: The folder to list. Leave it out for the finding folder.

functionDeclarations.name: read_file
functionDeclarations.description: Read one file. A Markdown or text file comes back as its text. A PDF, Word, Excel, CSV or email file in the finding folder comes back page by page as the check reads it, under headings such as ## Page 2, and names any page the reader found no text on.

path.description: The file, such as evidence/EV-07 report.pdf or kit/assistant/README.md.

page.description: Return only this page of a PDF, Word, Excel, CSV or email file.

functionDeclarations.name: write_file
functionDeclarations.description: Write a whole file, replacing what was there. Only the paths this job may write are accepted. Any other write is refused, changes nothing and is recorded.

content.description: The whole new text of the file.

message: INVALID_ARGUMENT API key not valid. Please pass a valid API key.

summary: gate, covers job in the drafter seat: 0 paths changed, 0 allowed, 0 written by the kit, 0 outside the job's allowlist.
